metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully searched for a one-way flight from Dublin to Vienna on June 10, 2026 for 2 adults on Ryanair. Demonstrated ability to increment passenger count via the + button in the passenger selector dialog.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Ryanair flight search form including passenger count adjustment. Agent clicked + once to go from 1 to 2 adults; clicking + twice achieves 3 adults.
metadata.explanation: Hardened variant increasing the passenger count from 2 to 3 adults. Agent must click the adults + button twice (not once as in original). Ryanair encodes adults count in the URL as 'adults=N'. The pattern 'adults=3' uniquely identifies 3-adult search. Initial homepage URL does not contain 'flights/select', so negative control fails. No custom functions needed.
